title: drain_once dead-letter count scans dead/ on every tick
description: relay_queue.rs drain_once (lines 341-363): counts files in dead/ via a full read_dir on every call to drain_once, including idle cycles triggered by the retry_interval timer. With a large dead/ directory this is an O(dead_count) filesystem scan per retry cycle. The dead/ count should be tracked incrementally (increment on move-to-dead, decrement on operator cleanup) or computed lazily only when the metric is actually scraped, not unconditionally on every drain tick.
